entities.summary: Vera Mikhailovna Velichkina (Russian: Вера Михайловна Величкина; was a Russian politician, physician, writer and revolutionary who was involved with the Bolshevik movement from the 1890s. After the October Revolution, she was tasked to organise Soviet health services. She was also a personal physician to Vladimir Lenin and was the first wife of politician Vladimir Bonch-Bruyevich.
